purpose: Read-only discovery of rendered-browser and browser-automation supply on the shared Ubuntu runtime.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,shutil
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
p=root/'canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('d',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
queries=['chromium browser','firefox browser','playwright','selenium webdriver']
out={q:m.search_apt_packages(q,limit=20).get('candidates',[])[:20] for q in queries}
installed={name:shutil.which(name) for name in ['chromium','chromium-browser','google-chrome','google-chrome-stable','firefox','firefox-esr']}
modules={name:bool(importlib.util.find_spec(name)) for name in ['playwright','selenium']}
print(json.dumps({'installed':installed,'python_modules':modules,'apt':out},sort_keys=True))
print('BROWSER_SUPPLY_DISCOVERY_COMPLETE')
PY
